certainty: Literal text establishes that this build contains distinct proxy handoff, TDR metalib/protocol-handler and initial-connection diagnostic paths. It does not establish which path actually executed or the corresponding function addresses.

unverified_raw_match.reason: The preceding bytes do not yield a valid known instruction boundary. Packed/protected raw file bytes cannot establish this as a real runtime code reference.

minimal_next_runtime_inspection.purpose: Locate only current-build code references to three fixed public static literals, without changing code, reading UI or retaining arbitrary process data.
minimal_next_runtime_inspection.pattern: x86 PUSH imm32: 68 followed by little-endian(actual_module_base + literal_rva); optionally validated MOV immediates if PUSH scan has no hits
minimal_next_runtime_inspection.bounds: Only committed executable pages within the known TGame first code section RVA0x1000..0x1A3D2EC, 64KiB reads; at most8 matches per literal; release each chunk after matching.
minimal_next_runtime_inspection.returned_evidence: For each validated match, only instruction RVA and bounded96 bytes before plus160 bytes after it; do not save whole sections or data pages.
minimal_next_runtime_inspection.reason_no_fixed_function_rva: No trustworthy function RVA can be derived from the protected on-disk code for these literals. Guessing PH addresses or treating the raw0x721DFA match as code would invent evidence.

important_boundaries: The literal ServInfo[0] names a diagnostic path; executable flow is needed before asserting this is the active endpoint or that selected index is ignored.
A zero signature-length diagnostic does not establish which research tag is responsible. Existing nonempty independent token already passes the DLL getter self-test.
Presence of DevLogin/force-parameter strings is not authorization or evidence that changing a flag bypasses required initialization.
Current sampled frame pacing is independent of the missing role/directory request; no reason to disable the frame wait.
